roles.name: Tank
roles.desc: Big HP pool. Enemies prefer to target you.

roles.name: Healer
roles.desc: Your aura slowly heals an ally standing near you, and you a little.

roles.name: DPS
roles.desc: Fragile, but deals the most damage.

weapons.name: Scattergun
weapons.desc: A short-range spread of 5 pellets. Point-blank (within 120 px), each pellet does double and shoves the enemy back.

weapons.name: Flak Cannon
weapons.desc: Shells fly over enemies to your cursor and burst in the air there (30 within 80 px), destroying enemy bullets caught in the burst.

weapons.name: Riot Repeater
weapons.desc: Steady single shots with a little spread. Each round that hits suppresses the enemy: it shoots 8% slower, up to 50% (25% for bosses), fading quickly.
weapons.extra: +1 round per burst (each trigger pull fires a burst, then a short pause)

weapons.name: Flamethrower
weapons.desc: A short-range stream of fire: each flame hits the first enemy for 3 and carries on through the rest for 1, setting them burning (5 a second for 3 s).
weapons.extra: +1 flame a burst and 25% more reach

weapons.name: Frost Lance
weapons.desc: A great icicle juts out from you (230 px), then splinters off its sides into enemies up to 60 px beside it (50% damage). Both slow.
weapons.extra: +30 px longer icicle, and its splinters fly 15 px further

weapons.name: Storm Hammer
weapons.desc: Throws a spinning hammer that smashes one enemy and electrifies it: for a second it arcs lightning to 3 enemies around it, three times, for a little damage.
weapons.extra: +15% hammer damage, and the electrified enemy arcs to 1 more enemy

weapons.name: Golem Staff
weapons.desc: Hold to heave a boulder, let go to throw it in an arc: the longer you hold, the farther it flies. It crushes everything where it lands. A stone Golem fights beside you and blocks bullets.

weapons.name: Bone Guard
weapons.desc: Bone darts that stick in enemies: the third in one enemy cages it for 1.5 s (not bosses). Two skeleton guards circle you, block bullets, and shoot at caged enemies.

weapons.name: Bear Totem
weapons.desc: Two quick claw swipes in front of you that make enemies bleed. A Bear companion mauls nearby enemies.
weapons.extra: +15 px reach, 25% more bleed, and your Bear's bites hit enemies around its target

weapons.name: Warhammer
weapons.desc: Hold to charge, let go to slam the ground in front of you (a 100 px wide strip). The longer the charge, the harder it hits (up to 80) and the longer it stuns (up to 0.9 s).
weapons.extra: +1 aftershock: another slam 0.2 s later, 40 px further out, at 60% damage

weapons.name: Lance
weapons.desc: A heavy jab in front of you that shoves enemies far back and stuns them for 1 s.
weapons.extra: +30 px reach, 24 px wider and +60 px knockback

weapons.name: Halberd
weapons.desc: Sweeps a long, thin blade across in front of you (200 px, 80°), hitting each enemy once a sweep.
weapons.extra: +30 px reach and a return sweep (60% damage)

weapons.name: Kusarigama
weapons.desc: Throw the chain-sickle straight out (280 px): it hooks the first enemy it hits (26). Fire again to reel yourself in to it and land a heavy slash (52, a 0.5 s stun).

weapons.name: Bo Staff
weapons.desc: A staff spun all the way around you (90 px) that cuts small bullets out of the air. Click while moving to vault 150 px, striking everything you pass (24); once every 1.2 s.
weapons.extra: +20 px reach and a 30 px longer vault

weapons.name: Fuma Shuriken
weapons.desc: A giant spinning star thrown in an oval loop 380 px out in front of you and back, cutting through everything both ways.

weapons.name: Blood Lash
weapons.desc: A whip of blood (130 px, 110°). Its tip cracks for double damage and taunts; enemies hit closer in are flung out to the tip. Each hit clots your blood (+1 Clot, +2 from the tip; 4% less damage taken each, up to 5). At full Clot your next lash bursts all round you.

weapons.name: Clot Bolt
weapons.desc: A heavy bolt (26) that leaves a pool of blood where it hits, slowing enemies in it by 40% for 3 s. After 1 s the pool congeals: enemies still in it are stuck for 1 s. You take 15% less damage standing in your own pool.

weapons.name: Leech Tendrils
weapons.desc: Hold to lash out blood tendrils in a 70° arc (160 px) that grasp up to 3 enemies while you hold on: they're stunned, take 12 damage a second per tendril, and 25% of it heals you. Spare tendrils join the ones already holding on.

weapons.name: Repulsion Cannon
weapons.desc: Blasts enemies away in a cone. Light damage; enemies it hits shed tiny health orbs.
weapons.extra: +20° wider blast, +2 damage and a harder push

weapons.name: Revolver
weapons.desc: Tap for aimed shots; hold to fan the hammer and empty the cylinder in a 10° arc. Six rounds, the last one heavy.
weapons.extra: +2 rounds in the cylinder, loaded as heavy rounds (double damage)

weapons.name: Mender's Bow
weapons.desc: Hold to draw, release to fire. A full draw (0.9 s) hits for 40, pierces 2 and heals an ally it passes for 20; let go right at full draw for a perfect shot (+25%).
weapons.extra: +1 arrow nocked: a full draw also looses an extra arrow (half damage) in a tight fan

weapons.name: Radiant Orb
weapons.desc: Hold to cast an orb of light out to your cursor; it stays there while you hold. Drag it through enemies to burn them (8, 5 times a second) and over allies to heal them.
weapons.extra: +1 light orb circling you that hurts enemies and heals allies it touches

weapons.name: Chain Light
weapons.desc: A great cone of light in front of you (320 px). Its 40 damage is shared between every enemy in it: one alone takes it all. Light arcs to each.

weapons.name: Prism Beam
weapons.desc: A rapid short-range beam. Shoot through an ally: it heals them and splits into three beams beyond them.

weapons.name: Sprite Staff
weapons.desc: Seed shots that stick in enemies. Two sprites fly to whoever is hurt and heal them, and every seeded enemy you kill frees another for 6 s (up to 4 more).

weapons.name: Treant Rod
weapons.desc: Bolts heal allies they pass. Your Treant roots where it stands and blocks bullets; a vine runs from you to it, healing allies who cross it and slowing enemies (it walks after you if you go too far).
weapons.extra: Your Treant grows 30% bigger: blocks more, hits harder and reaches farther

weapons.name: Totem Staff
weapons.desc: Seed shots. Every 10 s your next shot also throws a healing totem to your cursor (up to 400 px). Seed hits on enemies near your totems charge them: at 6, a totem pulses 25 healing to allies near it.

weapons.name: Quarterstaff
weapons.desc: Wide staff sweeps that knock enemies back and bat enemy bullets in the arc back at them (all but red aimed shots). Every enemy hit heals you and allies near you for 2 (up to 8 a swing).
weapons.extra: +1 strike with the other end of the staff (60% damage)

weapons.name: Lightbringer
weapons.desc: Sword swings that also send a short crescent of light, which heals allies it passes. Every enemy you hit fills a light gauge; at 12, your next swing's crescents heal three times as much.

weapons.name: Censer
weapons.desc: A flail whirled all the way around you. Each spin heals allies near you for 3. As you move it leaves a trail of incense (3 s) that heals allies in it, and enemy shots fired from inside it stray.
weapons.extra: +20 px reach and +1 HP healed per spin

weapons.name: Medicine Darts
weapons.desc: Fast needles that dose what they hit. Enemies: a stack of poison (2 a second for 3 s). Hurt allies: a stack of healing (2 a second for 3 s). Up to 5 stacks each.

weapons.name: Spirit Fan
weapons.desc: A short gust that heals allies in it for 3 and pushes small enemy bullets back. Shots alternate: one blows enemies in front away, the next draws them in.

weapons.name: Ofuda
weapons.desc: Paper charms fly to your cursor and lie there as wards (up to 5, for 10 s). An enemy that steps on one sets it off: 25 to enemies round it and 12 healing to allies near it.

weapons.name: Transfusion Darts
weapons.desc: Darts that transfuse your blood: one that reaches a hurt ally gives them 20 health for 4 of yours. Each enemy hit steals a sliver back (0.5).

weapons.name: Sanguine Orb
weapons.desc: Orbs of blood that home in at the last moment, circle an enemy and cover it (16, plus a bleed stack), charging your heal reserve. With 25 reserve, an orb that touches a hurt ally coats them in healing blood instead (30 health over 4 s).

weapons.name: Vein Tether
weapons.desc: A draining beam that hurts whatever you hold it on: keep it on your target. 40% of its damage heals, split between you and the nearest ally.

weapons.name: Twin Rifle
weapons.desc: Twin streams (5 per barrel) angled in to cross at your cursor's distance: hits where they cross are crossfire, for double.

weapons.name: Railgun
weapons.desc: Slow, devastating shots that pierce 3 enemies. The round's path stays charged for 1 s behind it, hurting anything in it (25 a second).
weapons.extra: Throws 2 shrapnel shards sideways at every enemy it pierces

weapons.name: Burst SMG
weapons.desc: Sprays very fast shots. Keep firing to spin it up (2 s): the spray tightens and damage climbs to +60%. It winds down fast when you stop.
weapons.extra: +1 bullet per shot, with a wider spray

weapons.name: Fireball
weapons.desc: A big, slow fireball that rolls on through every enemy in its path, hitting each (22) and setting it burning (8 a second for 3 s).

weapons.name: Arc Lightning
weapons.desc: Hold to charge a strip of ground in front of you, longer the longer you hold (160 px to half the arena). Let go: lightning shocks everything in it (40, and a 0.4 s stun).

weapons.name: Arcane Missiles
weapons.desc: Each cast conjures 3 missiles into orbit round you (up to 6). They launch at enemies within 300 px, homing, one after another. With the orbit full, a cast flies at your aim.
weapons.extra: +1 missile a cast, +2 in orbit, and faster launches

weapons.name: Wolf Whistle
weapons.desc: Darts mark the enemy they hit as prey, and your two wolves hunt it. When every wolf bites it within a second: a takedown (20 per wolf and a 0.6 s stun).

weapons.name: Wisp Lantern
weapons.desc: Three wisps orbit you, and they are your shots: each time you fire, one flies at the enemy nearest your cursor (22), strikes it and comes back.
weapons.extra: +1 Wisp, and each shot sends one more

weapons.name: Imp Caller
weapons.desc: An imp arrives every 3 s (up to 3) and waits by you. Tap fire to send them all charging at your cursor to explode (45 each); hold to merge them into one big imp whose blast is bigger than theirs put together.

weapons.name: Twin Blades
weapons.desc: Very fast alternating slashes. Land 10 in a row and your next one is a dash-strike: you lunge 140 px through enemies for triple damage.
weapons.extra: +1 cut: each swing strikes once more (60% damage)

weapons.name: Greatsword
weapons.desc: Huge sweeping cuts with long reach. Each sweep's edge hangs in the air for 0.5 s, a crescent of steel that stops enemy bullets.
weapons.extra: +1 sword beam: each sweep launches a piercing crescent (40% damage)

weapons.name: Rapier
weapons.desc: Precise thrusts at the nearest enemy in front. Each hit in a row on the same enemy deals 10% more (up to +60%). Each thrust skewers up to 3 enemy bullets along its line (not red aimed shots), and each adds to the streak.
weapons.extra: Skewers 1 more enemy behind the first

weapons.name: Shuriken
weapons.desc: Fans of 3 spinning stars that stick in what they hit (for 5 s). Double-tap fire to recall them: each rips out for another hit and flies back to you, cutting through what it passes.

weapons.name: Katana
weapons.desc: Fast 110° slashes. Hold off for 0.6 s and the blade is sheathed: your next cut is a quick-draw, 220 px long, through every enemy in its line for 2.5× damage.
weapons.extra: +1 cut: each slash strikes once more (60% damage)

weapons.name: Kunai
weapons.desc: Rapid throwing knives, +50% damage to enemies that aren't targeting you. Every 4th is a shadow kunai that leaves a mark where it lands: double-tap fire to blink there, and your next hit lands double.

weapons.name: Blood Bolts
weapons.desc: Fast bolts of blood (9) that stick in enemies: the fifth within 2 s makes it hemorrhage, bursting for 36 to it and every enemy within 80 px.

weapons.name: Implosion
weapons.desc: Click an enemy: its blood collapses inward (34), hurting enemies pressed against it (15) and pulling them in.
weapons.extra: +1 implosion: another enemy near your target collapses too (60% damage)

weapons.name: Bone Spear
weapons.desc: A heavy spear (60) that pierces 3 enemies. Each throw costs 2 health; the spear stays stuck where it stops (8 s), and walking over it gives the 2 back.
weapons.extra: +1 spear, fanned out (costs no more health)

Burster.name: Burster
Burster.blurb: Fires rings of bullets; more in each ring on later waves.

Sniper.name: Sniper
Sniper.blurb: Fast, accurate shots from far away.

Spinner.name: Spinner
Spinner.blurb: Wanders and sprays spirals in bursts; it spins up while bursting.

Boss.name: The Warden
Boss.blurb: Boss (wave 5): a prison riot in three stages — searchlight, gates and gas, then rioters.

Charger.name: Charger
Charger.blurb: Flashes a red line, then dashes along it and bursts into a ring.

Splitter.name: Splitter
Splitter.blurb: Splits into 3 fast Shards when killed.

Shard.name: Shard
Shard.blurb: Tiny and fast. Comes from Splitters, Nests and the Hive Queen.

Mortar.name: Mortar
Mortar.blurb: Lobs bombs at where you stand; they burst into a ring on landing.

Shielder.name: Shielder
Shielder.blurb: A front shield blocks shots and swings. It turns slowly: flank it.

Medic.name: Medic
Medic.blurb: Heals nearby enemies every few seconds. Kill it first.

HiveQueen.name: Hive Queen
HiveQueen.blurb: Boss (wave 10): a hive in three stages — drones and bombers, sealing cells and honey, then a frenzied swarm.

TwinA.name: Reaper of Dusk
TwinA.blurb: Boss pair (wave 15): a tether sweep, then they fuse into the Dual Reaper (pillars, holes), then split for a finale.

Singularity.name: The Singularity
Singularity.blurb: Boss (wave 20): corner gravity wells, pull, lasers and shrinking cages.

Phantom.name: Phantom
Phantom.blurb: Flickers, blinks next to you and bursts into a ring.

Hexer.name: Hexer
Hexer.blurb: Fires curving pincer shots that close in from both sides.

Juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
Juggernaut.blurb: Armored and slow, can't be slowed or knocked back. Rotating stars of orbs.

Nest.name: Nest
Nest.blurb: Stationary spawner that keeps hatching Shards until destroyed.

Colossus.name: The Colossus
Colossus.blurb: Boss (wave 25): huge stomp rings with one gap, and thrown rocks.

Duelist.name: The Duelist
Duelist.blurb: Boss (wave 30): teleports and leaves decoys that burst unless killed.

Lich.name: The Lich
Lich.blurb: Boss (wave 35): immune while its phylactery stands; raises skeletons.

StormHerald.name: Storm Herald
StormHerald.blurb: Boss (wave 40), three stages: a gathering storm (strikes, lightning rods), a gale that pushes you and bends bullets, then a supercell that marks one player at a time.

Devourer.name: The Devourer
Devourer.blurb: Boss (wave 45), three stages: hungry for morsels (your shots heal it), then swallowing players, then a mouth that heals it from the front.

Eclipse.name: The Eclipse
Eclipse.blurb: Final boss (wave 50), five stages and Totality: a sun and its moon. Hide in the moon's shadow from the flash, stay in the light, and kill it before the nova.

Swarmer.name: Swarmer
Swarmer.blurb: Small and fast melee rusher that weaves toward you in pairs.

Brute.name: Brute
Brute.blurb: Slow, tough melee bruiser that hits hard (24) when it reaches you.

Lunger.name: Lunger
Lunger.blurb: Circles in close, flashes a pink line, then leaps along it.

BeamSentry.name: Beam Sentry
BeamSentry.blurb: Plants itself, aims a line at you, then sweeps a beam across your side.

Scorcher.name: Scorcher
Scorcher.blurb: Circles you leaving a trail of embers. Cut across before it closes.

Reaver.name: Reaver
Reaver.blurb: Armoured melee: a red cone, then a rake. Open for a moment after: +50% damage.

Warder.name: Warder
Warder.blurb: Puts bubbles on up to three allies. Kill it and they all pop.

Barrier.name: Barrier
Barrier.desc: A bubble that stops incoming enemy bullets. Bosses can break it (it soaks 360 of their damage).
Barrier.capstone: Bullets that hit the barrier are reflected back as your own.

MendPulse.name: Mend Pulse
MendPulse.desc: Heal everyone nearby and revive downed allies.
MendPulse.capstone: Also erases enemy bullets within its range.

Shockwave.name: Shockwave
Shockwave.desc: Erase enemy bullets around you and damage nearby enemies.
Shockwave.capstone: Also knocks nearby enemies back 120 px.

Blink.name: Blink
Blink.capstone: Erases enemy bullets where you leave and where you land.

Nova.name: Nova
Nova.desc: Fire a ring of 24 heavy shots.

Turret.name: Turret
Turret.desc: Deploy a turret that shoots for 10 seconds.

Roar.name: Roar
Roar.desc: Every enemy targets you for 5 s, and you take 40% less damage meanwhile.
Roar.capstone: Also knocks enemies within 250 px back and slows them for 2 s.

Bulldoze.name: Bulldoze
Bulldoze.desc: Charge forward, damaging and knocking back everything in your path.
Bulldoze.capstone: Erases enemy bullets along the charge.

Haven.name: Haven
Haven.desc: Place a healing zone for 6 s. Allies inside regenerate fast and revive 3x quicker (alone: you heal 50% faster).
Haven.capstone: Allies inside also take 30% less damage.

SoulLink.name: Soul Link
SoulLink.desc: Tether to your ally for 6 s: they take half damage and you both regenerate. Alone, you link to a ghost of yourself that fights beside you.
SoulLink.capstone: Lasts 9 s, and both of you are invulnerable for 1 s when it starts.

Grenade.name: Cluster Grenade
Grenade.desc: Throw a grenade at your cursor that explodes into shrapnel.
Grenade.capstone: Throws a second grenade 80 px further.

Mark.name: Mark for Death
Mark.desc: Mark the enemy nearest your cursor: it takes 50% more damage for 6 s.
Mark.capstone: Marks the three enemies nearest your cursor.

BloodShell.name: Blood Shell
BloodShell.desc: Pay 15% of your max health for a shield worth three times as much, for 5 s.
BloodShell.capstone: Also erases enemy bullets within 160 px.

CrimsonPact.name: Crimson Pact
CrimsonPact.desc: Pay 10% of your max health: every enemy targets you for 4 s, then the damage you took meanwhile bursts back out at 150% within 220 px.
CrimsonPact.capstone: You take 30% less damage while it lasts.

Exsanguinate.name: Exsanguinate
Exsanguinate.desc: Pay 10% of your max health to pull enemies within 220 px toward you and drain 20 health from each into you.
Exsanguinate.capstone: Also slows the enemies it drains by 50% for 2 s.

BloodGift.name: Blood Gift
BloodGift.desc: Pay 25% of your current health: the most hurt ally heals twice as much. Alone, it becomes a shield for you.
BloodGift.capstone: Also heals everyone else within 200 px of them for half as much.

SiphonField.name: Siphon Field
SiphonField.desc: Pay 10% of your max health for a 140 px field at your feet for 6 s: enemies inside lose 10 HP/s and allies inside heal 10 HP/s.

Martyr.name: Martyr
Martyr.desc: Pay 40% of your max health to revive the downed ally nearest your cursor, anywhere, at 50% health. If no one is down, the most hurt ally (you, if you're alone) is warded for 12 s: if they go down, they get straight back up at 50%.
Martyr.capstone: You're invulnerable for 2 s after the sacrifice.

BloodBoil.name: Blood Boil
BloodBoil.desc: Pay 20% of your max health: enemies within 260 px boil and burst after 1 s for three times what you paid.
BloodBoil.capstone: Each burst also hits enemies within 80 px of it.

FrenzyPact.name: Frenzy Pact
FrenzyPact.desc: Pay 5% of your max health: for 6 s you fire 50% faster and heal 10% of the damage you deal, but lose 3 HP/s.

HemoNova.name: Hemo Nova
HemoNova.desc: Pay 10% of your max health to fire a ring of 16 blood bolts (20 each). Each that hits heals you 3.

BloodRite.name: Blood Rite
BloodRite.desc: For 8 s every enemy targets you and you take 60% less damage. The damage you take heals your allies.

SanguineRain.name: Sanguine Rain
SanguineRain.desc: For 6 s, every hit any ally lands heals them for 20% of its damage.

CrimsonApotheosis.name: Crimson Apotheosis
CrimsonApotheosis.desc: For 6 s you can't drop below 1 health and Blood Price can double your damage. When it ends, heal for half the damage you dealt.

ShieldWall.name: Shield Wall
ShieldWall.desc: Raise your shield for 4 s: it stops every enemy bullet coming at your front (120°), even red aimed shots. Bosses can break it (it soaks 400 of their damage).
ShieldWall.capstone: Bullets that hit the shield are reflected back as your own.

LeapSlam.name: Leap Slam
LeapSlam.desc: Leap to your cursor (up to 320 px), untouchable in the air. Landing deals 50 damage around you and stuns enemies for 1 s.
LeapSlam.capstone: The landing also erases enemy bullets within 160 px.

Unbreakable.name: Unbreakable
Unbreakable.desc: For 5 s you take 50% less damage and your hits heal you for 15% of the damage they deal.

Consecrate.name: Consecrate
Consecrate.desc: Bless the ground at your feet for 6 s: allies inside heal 12 HP/s and enemies burn for 20 damage a second.

GuardiansOath.name: Guardian's Oath
GuardiansOath.desc: Shield the ally nearest your cursor for 100 damage (and yourself for 50) for 6 s.
GuardiansOath.capstone: Everyone within 300 px gets the full shield.

LayOnHands.name: Lay on Hands
LayOnHands.desc: Heal the most hurt ally within 300 px (or yourself) for 70, or instantly revive them at half health if they're down.
LayOnHands.capstone: Also heals everyone else near them for half as much.

Whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
Whirlwind.desc: Spin for 2 s, hitting everything within 110 px for 12 every 0.2 s and slicing small bullets out of the air.
Whirlwind.capstone: Lasts 3 s and cuts every bullet except red aimed shots.

Lunge.name: Lunge
Lunge.desc: Dash 260 px toward your cursor, hitting everything you pass for 35. Two charges.

BattleFury.name: Battle Fury
BattleFury.desc: For 6 s you swing 40% faster and deal 25% more damage.

LastStand.name: Last Stand
LastStand.desc: For 8 s you can't drop below 1 HP, every enemy targets you, and you deal 50% more damage.

HallowedBlade.name: Hallowed Blade
HallowedBlade.desc: A giant holy sword falls at your cursor: 200 damage around it, then the ground is blessed for 8 s (allies heal 15 HP/s, enemies burn).
HallowedBlade.capstone: Three swords fall: one at your cursor and one either side.

BladeTempest.name: Blade Tempest
BladeTempest.desc: For 6 s every swing also hurls three piercing sword beams.
BladeTempest.capstone: Five sword beams a swing instead of three.

ArcaneAegis.name: Arcane Aegis
ArcaneAegis.desc: For 3 s, enemy bullets that touch you are reflected back as your own.
ArcaneAegis.capstone: Lasts 4.5 s and reflects bullets for double damage.

FrostNova.name: Frost Nova
FrostNova.desc: Freeze every enemy near you for 3 s and deal 40 damage.
FrostNova.capstone: Also erases enemy bullets around you.

FlameWall.name: Flame Wall
FlameWall.desc: A wall of fire at your cursor for 5 s: burns enemies and blocks bullets.
FlameWall.capstone: The fire also slows enemies by 40%.

TimeRewind.name: Time Rewind
TimeRewind.desc: Set everyone's health back to where it was 4 s ago, even undoing a downing.
TimeRewind.capstone: Also erases enemy bullets around every player.

ArcaneWard.name: Arcane Ward
ArcaneWard.desc: Shield you and allies within 300 px for 60 damage for 8 s. When a shield breaks or runs out, half of what it soaked comes back as healing.

Sanctify.name: Sanctify
Sanctify.desc: Erase enemy bullets around you and heal everyone nearby for 25.
Sanctify.capstone: Also freezes enemies around you solid for 1.5 s (not bosses).

Meteor.name: Meteor
Meteor.desc: Call a meteor at your cursor: after a short warning it hits for 150 damage.

Blizzard.name: Blizzard
Blizzard.desc: A storm at your cursor for 5 s that slows and damages enemies.

ArcaneSurge.name: Arcane Surge
ArcaneSurge.desc: For 5 s your shots deal 60% more damage and pierce 2 more enemies.

GolemWall.name: Golem Wall
GolemWall.desc: Raise three stone walls in front of you for 6 s that block bullets.

Earthquake.name: Earthquake
Earthquake.desc: You and every minion you have slam the ground, damaging and slowing enemies.
Earthquake.capstone: Also freezes the enemies it hits for 1 s (not bosses).

GuardianSpirit.name: Guardian Spirit
GuardianSpirit.desc: A guardian follows you for 8 s and absorbs every bullet near it.
GuardianSpirit.capstone: The guardian also heals you 6 HP/s.

Phoenix.name: Phoenix
Phoenix.desc: A phoenix fights for 10 s. If anyone goes down (you too), it revives them instantly.
Phoenix.capstone: Revives at full health, and the phoenix keeps fighting.

SoulLantern.name: Soul Lantern
SoulLantern.desc: For 5 s, allies near the lantern can't go down.

BatSwarm.name: Bat Swarm
BatSwarm.desc: Release 8 bats that hunt enemies for 6 s.

Sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
Sacrifice.desc: All your minions explode; your companions return 3 s later.
Sacrifice.capstone: Double explosion damage, and your companions return at once.

AlphaCall.name: Alpha Call
AlphaCall.desc: Your minions frenzy for 6 s: faster, and they attack twice as often.

ShadowClone.name: Shadow Clone
ShadowClone.desc: Leave a decoy for 5 s that every enemy targets. It bursts for 60 damage when it ends.

SmokeBomb.name: Smoke Bomb
SmokeBomb.desc: A 140 px cloud at your feet for 5 s: enemy bullets inside slow to half speed, and allies inside take 30% less damage.
SmokeBomb.capstone: Enemies inside the smoke are also slowed by 40%.

IronBody.name: Iron Body
IronBody.desc: For 2 s you take 80% less damage, then a shockwave hits everything within 140 px for 50.
IronBody.capstone: The shockwave also erases enemy bullets within 160 px.

HealingMist.name: Healing Mist
HealingMist.desc: A mist follows you for 6 s, shedding drops of dew around you (two a second, 10 healing each, lasting 6 s) for you and your allies to pick up.

Substitution.name: Substitution
Substitution.desc: Swap places with the ally nearest your cursor and shield them for 60 for 6 s. Alone: slip to your cursor and shield yourself.
Substitution.capstone: You and your ally are both invulnerable for 1 s after the swap.

SpiritWard.name: Spirit Ward
SpiritWard.desc: Plant a talisman at your cursor for 8 s: it takes the damage allies near it would take (up to 150). When it breaks or ends, a quarter of what it took heals allies near it.

ShadowStep.name: Shadow Step
ShadowStep.desc: Teleport behind the enemy nearest your cursor (up to 450 px away) and strike it for 80.

Vanish.name: Vanish
Vanish.desc: For 3 s enemies lose track of you. Your next hit (within 4 s) deals double damage.
Vanish.capstone: Erases enemy bullets around you when you vanish.

BladeFan.name: Blade Fan
BladeFan.desc: Throw 12 kunai in a ring around you, 18 damage each.

ThousandClones.name: Thousand Clones
ThousandClones.desc: Five clones surround you for 8 s: every enemy targets them, and each bursts for 60 when it ends.

BlossomStorm.name: Blossom Storm
BlossomStorm.desc: For 5 s petals heal the whole party 20 HP/s and erase enemy bullets near every ally.

DeathLotus.name: Death Lotus
DeathLotus.desc: Strike up to 8 enemies near your cursor in a flurry of cuts, 100 damage each.

StunGun.name: Stun Gun
StunGun.desc: Draw a stun gun: your next 6 shots are stun bolts (15 damage) that stun enemies for 1.5 s (bosses are only slowed). The cooldown starts once all 6 are fired.

Fortress.name: Fortress
Fortress.desc: For 8 s every enemy targets you and you take 75% less damage. Erases nearby bullets and shoves enemies away.

GlacialTomb.name: Glacial Tomb
GlacialTomb.desc: Erase every enemy bullet and freeze every enemy solid for 4 s (bosses take 250 damage instead).
GlacialTomb.capstone: Enemies stay frozen for 6 s and bosses take 500.

Titan.name: Titan
Titan.desc: Summon a stone titan for 15 s that smashes enemies and blocks bullets (it soaks 1000 boss damage).
Titan.capstone: The titan is bigger and stays for 25 s.

Lifeline.name: Lifeline
Lifeline.desc: Instantly revive and fully heal the whole party, with 3 s of invulnerability.
Lifeline.capstone: Everyone also gets 4 s of Overdrive.

Sanctum.name: Sanctum
Sanctum.desc: A holy dome for 7 s: allies inside heal fast and can't go down, and bullets can't get in.
Sanctum.capstone: The dome is half again as wide (300 px).

WorldTree.name: World Tree
WorldTree.desc: Grow a great tree for 10 s that heals allies, entangles enemies around it and sends out healing sprites.

BulletStorm.name: Bullet Storm
BulletStorm.desc: For 6 s you fire three times as fast, with +2 extra projectiles.

MeteorStorm.name: Meteor Storm
MeteorStorm.desc: Twelve meteors rain down on enemies over 3 s, 150 damage each.

Legion.name: Legion
Legion.desc: Summon 6 wolves and 6 bats for 10 s, and all your minions frenzy.
